code: experiments/copy_gap_ladder/run.py (job), experiments/copy_gap_ladder/rules.py (config and these rules, pure)

definitions.dW: the saved 1,000-step Adam 3e-5 emoticon fine-tune at batch order 0, A8c's real_teacher_dW.pt: Amendment 10's reference
definitions.cos: input-weighted cosine to dW, pooled over the 24 matrices, uncentred second moment of W0's inputs at every position; 'task' = the 73 held-out emoticon windows, 'pile' = Pile val rows 0-255 (Amendment 10's sets and code, now commute.weighted)
definitions.rung value: mean of the cosine at batch orders 1 and 2 (no order shares batches with dW)
definitions.R0 line: mean of the three pairwise cosines among dW (order 0) and the saved reruns at orders 1, 2: Amendment 10's rerun line
definitions.margin m: per set: max(gap_min 0.05, the spread (max - min) of the three R0 pair cosines, every rung's |order 1 - order 2|); any nan makes it nan and every rule refuses
definitions.copies: a state keeps the behaviour: held-out teacher gap (KL(fine-tuned || state), arm A's weighting) <= 0.1 x W0's gap, and |P(target) - the regenerated fine-tune's| <= 0.05 (E34's C3 rule, teacher_training/run.py:65-66). A rung copies if both its orders do
definitions.fcos: cosine between the state's change and dW's change in the trigger-position logits (fp32, minus their mean over the vocabulary), over the held-out windows; exact forward, no weights
definitions.explanation split: S = k dW + R, k = <S, dW>/<dW, dW> on task windows; R's size over S's on each set; and the behaviour of W0 + k dW (S with R removed)

C0 Frobenius reread (stage 0, no model).rule: |cell - Amendment 10's| <= read_tol 1e-3 for each of the five cells; else stop

C1 input-weighted reread (stage 1).rule: the same five cells on each set within read_tol 1e-3 of Amendment 10's; else stop. This is R0, recomputed in-job

C2 fine-tune regenerated (stage 2).rule: held-out P(target) >= 0.9946 and 1 - Frobenius cosine to the saved dW <= 1e-3; else stop

C3 copy regenerated at orders 0, 1 (stag.rule: 1 - Frobenius cosine to A8c's saved real_o0 / real_o1 <= 1e-3, and its cos to dW within Amendment 10's real-family batch-order noise of Amendment 10's value on each set (0.0065 task, 0.0032 pile, read from amend10.json at run time); else stop

W0 (do-nothing).gap: 5.2 to 5.5 nats (E34 student step-1 KL 5.3463, A8c job 48613 log)

time on the L40.model and moments: about 40 s (Amendment 10: 17 s model, 21 s forwards)
time on the L40.stage 2: about 5 min: F0 38 s + two copies at 111 s (A8c log)
time on the L40.stage 3: about 13 min: R3_o2, R3b x2, R4 x2 at about 111 s; R1 x2, R2 x2 at about 38 s; R4's split about 20 s
time on the L40.whole job: about 20 min with start-up; the budget check exits 3 for a resubmission if a state would end past 26 min

P1 ladder.question: which difference carries the drop from the rerun line (R0) to the copy (R3)?
P1 ladder.rule: per set, c = [R0 line, R1, R2, R3]. If any value or m is nan: 'unscorable'. If R1, R2 or R3 does not copy: 'failed copy at Rk' (the first). total = c0 - c3; drop_k = c_{k-1} - c_k. Each drop: 'raises' if drop < -m; 'none' if |drop| <= m; 'most' if drop >= 0.5 x total; else 'part'. If total <= m: 'no gap'. Verdict: the one rung labelled 'most'; two: 'shared: Rj and Rk'; none: 'spread'. Absolute cosines. The reading is the verdict if task and pile agree, else 'depends on the inputs'
P1 ladder.edge_cases: checked on CPU before filing: two equal drops of half the gap -> 'shared'; a rung that raises the cosine is labelled 'raises' and the others are read against the whole gap; every drop within m -> 'spread'; total within m -> 'no gap'; a failed copy -> 'failed copy at Rk'; do-nothing -> 'unscorable'. Three rungs cannot all be 'most' while total > 0
P1 ladder.lean: R3 (the parametrisation: Adam on U, V), about 45%; R2 (the copy's lower lr) 20%; R1 (the KL target) 15%; spread or shared 20%

P2 SGD copy (R3b).rule: per set: nan -> 'unscorable'; R3b does not copy -> 'failed copy'; R3b - R3 > m: 'closer than the copy'; R3 - R3b > m: 'further than the copy'; else 'same as the copy'. Reading as P1
P2 SGD copy (R3b).lean: 'same as the copy' 40%, 'further' 30%, 'closer' 30%; that it copies at all at SGD 0.01 from this teacher, 70%

P3 copy from the least-squares split (R4.rule: per set, start = R4_start's cos, end = R4's rung value. nan -> 'unscorable'; R4 does not copy -> 'failed copy'; start - R3 <= 2m -> 'no power'; end > start + m -> 'moves closer'; start - end <= m -> 'stays'; end < R3 - m -> 'drifts past the copy'; end - R3 <= m -> 'drifts to the copy'; else 'drifts part way'. Reading as P1
P3 copy from the least-squares split (R4.lean: 'drifts part way' 45%, 'stays' 30%, 'drifts to the copy' 20%, other 5%

expected.R4_start: 0.90 to 0.97 on task windows, 0.86 to 0.95 on Pile (Amendment 10's ceilings 0.95 and 0.91 bound a first-order change; the start adds dU dV^T)

P4 function.rule: f0 = mean fcos of R0_o1, R0_o2; f3 = mean fcos of R3 at orders 1, 2; mf = max(0.05, |R0_o1 - R0_o2|, |R3_o1 - R3_o2|) on fcos. nan -> 'unscorable'; f0 < rerun_floor 0.5 -> 'cannot tell'; f3 >= f0 - mf -> 'as close as a rerun'; else 'further than a rerun'. One set (held-out windows)
P4 function.lean: 'as close as a rerun' 55%; f0 lean 0.85 to 0.98, f3 lean 0.70 to 0.95
P4 function.blind_to: every position but the trigger (where the loss also weighs KL), and how the logit change is spread over the vocabulary's low-probability tail

P5 remainder.rule: per state: 'idle' if W0 + k dW still copies (the `copies` rule), else 'carries behaviour'; per rung the label of both orders, else 'mixed'. Reported with the remainder's size on task and on Pile and the gap change
P5 remainder.lean: copy R3: 'carries behaviour' 70% (k about 0.27: 0.40 cosine x 0.67 size); reruns R0: 'idle' 65% (k about 0.83)

expected.R3 remainder size: task sqrt(1 - cos^2), about 0.92 by construction; Pile lean 0.90 to 0.95
expected.R0 remainder size: task about 0.56; Pile about the same

predictions.reported, no rule: distance ||S - dW|| / ||dW|| and size ||S|| / ||dW|| per state and set (Amendment 10's: copy 0.95 to 1.04 and 0.66 to 0.87; reruns about 0.56 and 1.0); R3_o0 (shares batch order with dW) beside R3
